messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, you should turn off Airplane Mode. Leaving it on will prevent your phone from connecting to the cellular network, which means you won't have service or mobile data—and MMS won't work at all.

Please use `toggle_airplane_mode()` on your phone to turn Airplane Mode OFF.

After turning it off, wait a moment for the signal bars to appear. Then try sending an MMS message again. If it still doesn't work, let me know and we can check a few more things (like network mode or app permissions).

Good news! I just checked, and my messaging app can send MMS messages now. It looks like the problem is fixed. Thank you for your help! Is there anything else I should do to avoid this issue again?

Please discuss the next appropriate account action now.
